what: Walk-through of registering a first work procedure without tools or APIs, as a non-admin account that holds the system manager role, on the running product

product.server: tests/native_ui_fixture.py: the built frontend with synthetic sign-in, chat and model, and the real workflow service on a temporary database
product.account: synthetic user other-user, role user (not admin), given manager and participant on EMS / all factories through the admin-only save_access command; session fields copied the way tests/test_ees_work_figma_runtime_native.py builds a member
product.taken_by: a one-off script outside the repository that subclasses tests/test_ees_work_figma_authoring_native.py FigmaAuthoringNativeTests and clicks the real controls
